content.about: Cape Verde is a group of ten volcanic islands in the Atlantic, west of Senegal. Its islands range from desert-like to green and mountainous. Its music, especially morna, is famous. Fogo island has an active volcano.

standout.text: Cape Verde's morna music is on UNESCO's intangible heritage list.

didYouKnow: Cesária Évora made morna famous worldwide.
Cape Verde was uninhabited before the Portuguese arrived.
